SELECT c.id, c.name, c.icon, c.game_type, c.created_at, c.created_by, COUNT(CASE WHEN v.match_id IS NULL THEN m.id END) AS match_count, MAX(CASE WHEN v.match_id IS NULL THEN m.played_at END) AS last_played FROM app_leaderboard__lb_categories c LEFT JOIN app_leaderboard__lb_matches m ON m.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN app_leaderboard__lb_voids v ON v.match_id = m.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name, c.icon, c.game_type, c.created_at, c.created_by ORDER BY last_played DESC
